name: Ejentum Self-Inspect
description: Reasoning harness for agentic AI — dynamically selects cognitive strategies during task execution to prevent compounding errors in multi-step agent chains.

tools.name: self_inspect
tools.description: Self-Inspect. Express a thought, or describe the task you are working on, and you always get back ONE metathought: a short abstract question that makes you inspect your own task and assumptions before continuing. Use it whenever you want a self-check: after forming a hypothesis, before committing to an answer, when a long chain feels like it has drifted, when you notice you are agreeing to please, or when you are about to assert something from memory. There is no failure case: it always returns a metathought to question yourself with, selected by a transparent heuristic over an open CSV (no LLM). Keyless and free. DO NOT call for factual lookups or as a substitute for doing the task. Absorb the question and act on it; do not echo it verbatim to the user.

thought.description: A free-text thought or a description of the task you are working on. Express what you are doing or thinking; the more concrete, the sharper the returned question.
